name: MultiTEND
description: MultiTEND is the first and largest multilingual benchmark for natural language to NoSQL query generation, covering six languages. It enables evaluation of multilingual challenges in translating natural language to NoSQL queries, addressing lexical and syntactic differences across languages.
reputation: A recent benchmark from the literature that is gaining attention for multilingual text-to-NoSQL evaluation, but it is not yet a widely established standard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on multilingual NoSQL query generation; includes analysis of lexical and syntactic challenges; introduces MultiLink framework for improved performance.
